validationProtocol.acceptance: Both evaluators independently confirm the initial state, action order, causal callback chain, and semantic postcondition. Resolve disagreements before using a scenario as ground truth.
validationProtocol.completionRule: All required actions and required trace events occur in order, no forbidden event occurs, and every semantic postcondition evaluates true. Animation invocation alone is insufficient.

traceVocabulary.Action: A player- or MCP-initiated operation, such as grabbing, moving, or placing an object.
traceVocabulary.Callback: A Unity or application callback caused by an action, such as OnTriggerEnter or a raycast connection change.
traceVocabulary.StateTransition: A recorded before/after change to application state.
traceVocabulary.Postcondition: A semantic completion oracle evaluated after the causal chain.
traceVocabulary.alternative: One of the listed equivalent observations is sufficient.

scenarios.title: Place the Objet1 key object to open a door
initialState: The target collider_porte instance is active.
The associated door is closed and its NavMesh passage is blocked.
An interactable object tagged Objet1 is outside the trigger.
postconditions: The placed object is snapped at the trigger and can no longer be manipulated.
The trigger object is inactive and openTrigger is false.
The door-open animation was requested and the associated NavMesh obstacle is disabled.
failureRules: Reject if the object never enters the trigger or has a tag other than Objet1.
Reject if the trigger is consumed but the passage remains blocked.
Reject if a movement action reports that its destination is not reachable on the NavMesh.

scenarios.title: Place sphere, cube, and pyramid in their matching Room 2 receptacles
initialState: Room 2 SphereChecked, CubeChecked, PyramidChecked, and doorOpen are false.
Sphere_salle2, Cube_salle2, and Pyramid_salle2 are movable and not snapped.
The three matching receptacles are active.
The Room 2 door is closed and its NavMesh passage is blocked.

actions.note: The three placements may occur in any permutation.

dependencyEdges: matching tag and receptacle flag -> matching Set*Check
postconditions: All three check flags and doorOpen are true.
Each shape is snapped to its matching receptacle and is no longer manipulable.
The Room 2 door-open animation was requested and its NavMesh obstacle is disabled.
failureRules: A wrong-tag object entering a receptacle does not count as a placement.
Duplicate placement of one shape cannot substitute for a missing shape.
Reject if doorOpen occurs before all three distinct check transitions.
Reject if any required move reports an unreachable NavMesh destination.

scenarios.title: Interrupt both Room 3 laser-to-receiver paths to open the door
initialState: Both Sender instances are connected to Receiver-tagged targets.
room3.laser1, laser2, and doorOpen are false.
The Room 3 door is closed, its passage is blocked, and the completion audio is not playing.
dependencyEdges: obstruction in each beam -> non-Receiver raycast hit
non-Receiver hit while connected -> isConnected false
doorOpen -> DoorOpen animation + audio + passage unblocked
postconditions: laser1, laser2, and doorOpen are true.
Both senders are disconnected from their receivers at completion.
The Room 3 door-open animation and completion audio were requested, and its NavMesh obstacle is disabled.
failureRules: Reject if the same sender toggles twice while the other remains connected.
Reject if a receiver-connected/laser-cleared event occurs before final evaluation and either laser flag becomes false.
Reject if audio or animation occurs without the doorOpen state transition and true postcondition.
